messages:
maria (ML): quick heads-up — during v2 bring-up with int8 we saw a ~3.2pt NDCG@10 drop on the prod-holdout after the new doc->passage parser landed. MRR roughly flat. anyone seen a similar footprint?

tuan (Rerank): can you paste the eval command + a couple sample queries?

maria (ML): eval cmd: `./eval_rerank --model rnk-v2-int8 --cohort=prod_holdout --format=passage_split --seed=42 --k=10`
example query: "how to factory reset my router" (originally single-line, now parser outputs multi-line passages)

kevin (Infra): did the tokenizer change? we pushed an html-cleaner tweak yesterday that collapses whitespace and removes repeated newlines — that can shift prefix tokens and priming context.

maria (ML): checked token diffs: mean tokens/doc went 124 -> 118 after parser+cleaner. NDCG@10 delta -0.032, MRR@10 ~ -0.002 (noise). tail ranks down more than head.

frances (Data): any chance we introduced prompt scaffolding? i.e. we prepend contextual labels when we split passages (e.g., "Passage 1:"). rerankers are sensitive to small context markers.

maria (ML): yes — the splitter now inserts short headings: "Context:" for each passage. i didn't think it would matter but looks correlated.

kevin (Infra): also confirm PTQ config — are we using per-channel quant or per-tensor? different clipping can amplify small input shifts. paste config?

maria (ML): PTQ cfg (quick): `mode: perchannel, clip: mse, calib_samples: 512, per_token_scale: false`

sam (Ops): i can run a targeted ablation: (A) passage_split with headings, (B) passage_split without headings, (C) whole_doc. will spin up a 2k query smoke. who owns candidate-pool diffs?

ops-bot: job rerank-smoke-6380012345 started by sam — link: https://ci.internal/jobs/6380012345

maria (ML): thanks. also noticed candidate ordering changed due to dedupe tweak upstream which removes near-duplicates earlier in the pipeline. might interact with passage boundaries.

tuan (Rerank): plan: 1) run ablation A/B/C and compare NDCG/MRR deltas per slice (short vs long docs), 2) diff tokenization at the model input level, 3) compare candidate pools pre/post-dedupe. i'll take 1+2, sam take 3?

sam (Ops): taking candidate diffs now.

kevin (Infra): if ablation confirms headers as the culprit, add a unit test preventing insertion of free-text labels into ranking inputs. also add an automated golden check: run 1k golden queries and block rollout if NDCG@10 drops > 1.5pt.

maria (ML): agreed. quick ablation results (smoke job finished):
- A (heading + passage_split): NDCG@10 -3.1pt
- B (no heading + passage_split): NDCG@10 -0.4pt
- C (whole_doc): NDCG@10 -0.2pt
So the big hit correlates with the small heading insertion.

frances (Data): that's surprisingly strong. likely reranker models learned fragile heuristics on separator tokens. we should sanitize splitters to avoid any free-text markers.

maria (ML): candidate diff (sam): no meaningful change in topk identities, ordering mismatch minor. so candidate pool not primary.

kevin (Infra): ok rollback parser patch for v2 bringup. add a post-merge lint that flags any text prefix/suffix inserted by preprocessors.

maria (ML): next steps: revert header insertion, re-run int8 bringup smoke, and add a 1k golden eval gate. i've opened a PR with the revert + tests.

tuan (Rerank): i'll add a small eval slice to CI that compares token distributions (mean, std, common tokens) to catch silent tokenizer drift.

sam (Ops): candidate-diff job done — no upstream cause. posting diff: https://internal.storage/diffs/6380012345.txt

maria (ML): thanks all. reconvene at 11:30 standup to confirm rollback and final numbers. :thumbsup:

maria (ML): final note — logging: store raw pre-split text in artifact store for future forensic. saved current smoke outputs + per-query traces to GDrive: https://gdrive.redwood/reports/6380012345
